summary: Per-line glyph metric/layout state used while a text box emits glyph quads: it carries the x/y scale, the pen advance, the glyph sheet handle and a cache of 0x24-byte glyph records.
evidence: Ui_Font_LoadGlyphSheet multiplies by the scale at +8 and branches on the byte at +0x2C; Ui_Font_ParseGlyphTable divides glyph UVs by the sheet width/height, appends 0x24-byte records to the cache at +0x28 and copies the byte at +0x2D into each record; Ui_Font_GetKerningOffset writes the glyph sheet's output record.

fields.name: maybe_charCode
fields.evidence: GetKerningOffset copies *fontContext into the output glyph record field +0x18; the value is read as one word and never interpreted.

fields.name: maybe_styleId
fields.evidence: GetKerningOffset copies fontContext[1] into the output record field +0x1C next to the word above.

fields.name: scaleX
fields.evidence: LoadGlyphSheet computes 'fVar1 = glyphWidth * *(float *)(self + 8)' and ParseGlyphTable scales quad widths by '(float)self[2]'.

fields.name: scaleY
fields.evidence: ParseGlyphTable uses '(float)self[3]' as the vertical scale in the same quad-size expression as +8.

fields.name: advanceX
fields.evidence: LoadGlyphSheet ends with 'self->f_10 = self->f_10 + fVar1', accumulating the glyph advance.

fields.name: penY
fields.evidence: ParseGlyphTable starts from 'fVar11 = (float)self[5]' and subtracts half the line height when the +0x2C flag is set - a vertical pen position.

fields.name: fixedAdvance
fields.evidence: LoadGlyphSheet uses 'fVar1 = *(float *)(self + 0x1C)' as the advance instead of the glyph width when the byte at +0x2C is set.

fields.name: maybe_quadHeightScale
fields.evidence: ParseGlyphTable multiplies quad width by '(float)param_1[8]' and the line scale, i.e. a per-glyph vertical size factor.

fields.name: glyphSheet
fields.evidence: param_1[9] is dereferenced for its vtable slots +0x0C/+0x78 and its byte +5 selects the UV branch in ParseGlyphTable.

fields.name: glyphCache
fields.evidence: param_1[10] points to {capacity at +0, count at +4, record base at +8}; entries are 0x24 bytes and the count is incremented per glyph.

fields.name: maybe_absoluteMetrics
fields.evidence: LoadGlyphSheet tests 'if (self->f_2C == 0)' to decide whether to scale the glyph metrics by +8.

fields.name: maybe_textureIndex
fields.evidence: ParseGlyphTable copies '*(u8 *)((int)param_1 + 0x2D)' into each emitted glyph record at byte offset 0x20.

summary: Numeric tween that moves a current value toward a target by a fixed per-frame step and drives an embedded Ui_AnimRef; used by HP-bar and dungeon row animations.

fields.evidence: StepToTarget only advances the value when 'self->f_7C != 0' (window code guards the call the same way).

summary: Bound layout-animation reference used by ~130 UI windows: layout + animation resource handle, embedded bound element, current frame, dirty flag and pane variant state.
evidence: Ui_AnimRef_Bind stores the layout at +0, the animation clip handle at +4, resolves the bound pane at +8, and plays the clip; SetFrame writes the float frame at +0x18, sets +0x1C = 1 and clears the low 3 bits of +0x34.

fields.name: layout
fields.evidence: Bind ends with '*anim = layout' and ResetPanes uses '*anim' as the layout whose pane list is walked.

fields.name: animHandle
fields.evidence: Bind stores Ui_AnimClip_LoadResource(layout,name) at anim[1]; BindByName stores the 'mina' animation handle there.

fields.name: animator
fields.evidence: SetFrame/MarkDirty/ResetPanes all bail out unless 'anim->f_14 != 0'; ResetPanes then calls the pane-binding helpers on it.

fields.name: frame
fields.evidence: SetFrame writes the float argument at +0x18 ('anim->f_18 = in_s0') and MarkDirty keeps the existing value.

fields.name: isDirty
fields.evidence: SetFrame and MarkDirty both write 1 to +0x1C after changing the frame.

fields.name: maybe_frameCache
fields.evidence: both SetFrame and MarkDirty zero +0x2C when a new frame is set (a float constant is mentioned in the doc); purpose not recovered.

fields.name: flags
fields.evidence: SetFrame/MarkDirty do 'anim->f_34 = anim->f_34 & 0xfffffff8', clearing the low three flag bits.

fields.name: maybe_variantRecord
fields.evidence: maybe_Ui_AnimRef_UpdateVariantState reads 'self->f_38->f_C' as a small variant id (< 4) when deciding whether to show the bound node.

fields.name: variantIndex
fields.evidence: the same function bounds 'self->f_49 < 5' and indexes table 0x0072D430 by it before refreshing the node.

fields.name: maybe_uiNode
fields.evidence: 0x0047432C calls self->f_31C->vt[+0x18](node, 0/1) to hide/show the bound layout node and vt[+0x5C]() to query it.

summary: Hat ('boushi') preview part of the equipment screen: owns a 0x5E0-byte model-ish child, a Ui_Slot, and the boushi_text.bxon / boushi_msg.bxon layout nodes with their packed handles.
evidence: Ui_BoushiPart_Ctor installs vtable 0x0075B71C, finds boushi_text.bxon and boushi_msg.bxon through the UI core, creates a 0x5E0-byte child (Ui_BoushiShopWindow_Ctor) at +4 and a 300-byte Ui_Slot at +8.

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: ctor writes 0x0075B71C into *self; the vtable at 0x0075B71C has slots for Ui_BoushiPart_Release/Dtor.

fields.name: modelObject
fields.evidence: ctor allocates 0x5E0 bytes, constructs it with Ui_BoushiShopWindow_Ctor, registers it via Ui_Object_CreatePartsFromTable and stores it in self[1].

fields.name: slot
fields.evidence: ctor allocates 300 bytes, calls Ui_Slot_Init and stores the object in self[2] with active flag f_94 = 0.

fields.name: textLayout
fields.evidence: ctor stores the boushi_text.bxon layout node whose pane-array owner index is 1 into self[3].

fields.name: textLayoutHandle
fields.evidence: ctor keeps the packed handle of that layout node in self[4] (invalid value 0xFFFFF000 before init).

fields.name: msgLayout
fields.evidence: ctor stores the boushi_msg.bxon layout node whose pane-array owner index is 8 into self[5].

fields.name: msgLayoutHandle
fields.evidence: ctor keeps the packed handle of the message layout node in self[6].

fields.name: unknown_58
fields.evidence: the evidence line 'iVar4 = puVar3[0x16]' reads word 0x16 of the loaded layout resource, not of this object; no real +0x58 access.

fields.name: unknown_5c
fields.evidence: the evidence line '0x27 < (uint)puVar3[0x17]' reads the layout resource's word 0x17, not this object.

fields.name: unknown_60
fields.evidence: the evidence line 'puVar3[0x18] = iVar4' writes the layout resource's word 0x18, not this object.

summary: Casino / medal-prize label window: it formats a counter and a product into two panes identified by the pane index at +0x28; the 'DebugLabel' prefix is inherited and not confirmed.
evidence: 0x003E9E60/0x003E9EF8/0x003EA050 format a counter and 'count * unitPrice' into panes '+0x28 << 16' and '+0x28 << 16 | 1'; callers are Ui_MedalPrizeWindow_Ctor, Ui_PokerWindow_Payout and Ui_CasinoPrizeWindow_Ctor.

fields.name: paneIndex
fields.evidence: every setter calls func_001A6680(self, (u32)self->f_28 << 0x10 | n, text) - the pane id is built from this value.

fields.name: unitPrice
fields.evidence: the product setter formats '(int)self->f_50 * self->f_4C' with '%02d', so +0x4C is the per-unit value.

fields.name: count
fields.evidence: the product setter formats '(int)*(char *)(param_1 + 0x50)' and multiplies it by +0x4C.

fields.name: unknown_a0
fields.evidence: evidence 'FUN_003EB568(*(int *)(*param_1 + 0x28) + 0x1DA0, ...)' dereferences the object's vtable (slot 10), not a field at +0xA0.

fields.name: unknown_b0
fields.evidence: evidence 'FUN_002F6B0C(*(undefined4 *)(*param_1 + 0x2C))' dereferences the vtable (slot 11), not a field at +0xB0.

fields.name: maybe_memberSource
fields.evidence: read as a pointer ('*(u8 *)(*(int *)(param_1 + 0x208) + 0x768)' = character id) in one routine but as a u16 value in FUN_005E5C40; the field type is not settled.

fields.name: maybe_valueA
fields.evidence: the label routine passes +0x20C and +0x210 together as two integer arguments (formatted with '%d' into message slots 8 and 9).

fields.name: maybe_valueB
fields.evidence: second of the two integer arguments read as '(param_1 + 0x20C), (param_1 + 0x210)'.

fields.name: maybe_flag214
fields.evidence: a routine tests 'if (*(char *)(param_1 + 0x214) == 0)' before doing its work.

fields.name: maybe_memberIndex
fields.evidence: FUN_0035EB98(gamework, *(u8 *)(param_1 + 0x215)) resolves a party-member record and the same byte is passed to FUN_005E5C40 as a flag.

summary: Shared item-list core for the item, equipment and shop menus: embeds a filtered ItemList_Iterator, a list widget, a second state iterator and the Ui_Menu category label.
evidence: Ui_ItemListCore_Ctor installs vtable 0x0077AECC, sets +0x58 = 0 and constructs the embedded ItemList_Iterator at +0x5C with entry width 0x11; SetMode/InitState store the mode at +0x7C/+0x2448 and re-init the iterators at +0x5C/+0x2428.

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: ctor writes g_004E3F90 (0x0077AECC) into *puVar1.

fields.name: iteratorRef
fields.evidence: SetMode writes '&self->f_17' (= +0x5C) here and ApplyMode only refreshes when it is non-null; ctor clears it.

fields.name: iterator
fields.evidence: ctor calls ItemList_Iterator_Ctor(puVar1 + 0x17) and sets its vtable to 0x0077876C and entry width f_20 = 0x11; SetMode/ApplyMode re-init it.

fields.name: listMode
fields.evidence: SetMode stores the mode byte at self->f_1F and ApplyMode re-initialises the iterator with '(char)self[0x1F]'.

fields.name: unknown_170
fields.evidence: only evidence is a vtable slot call '(**(code **)(*param_1 + 0x5C))(param_1)'; no field at +0x170 is accessed.

fields.name: maybe_listWidget
fields.evidence: InitState calls self->f_23CC->vt[+0x5C](&self->f_23CC) to refresh the list; the embedded object spans +0x23CC..+0x2424.

fields.name: iteratorLink
fields.evidence: InitState sets self->f_2424 = self + 0x2428, a pointer to the state iterator that follows.

fields.name: stateIterator
fields.evidence: InitState calls ItemList_Iterator_Init(&self->f_2428) on this embedded iterator.

fields.name: stateMode
fields.evidence: InitState stores its mode argument at self->f_2448.

fields.name: menu
fields.evidence: InitState calls Ui_Menu_SetCategoryText(&self->f_24B4), i.e. an inline Ui_Menu/label object at the end of the core.
